subject.title: [Bug]: Windows Scheduled Task gateway restart/health becomes inconsistent after ready

question: Which Windows Scheduled Task restart path should own the remaining broad fix before more automation is queued for this issue?
rationale: The issue now spans partially fixed subsets plus open narrower issues/PRs, so a maintainer needs to choose whether to land/narrow those paths first or keep this as the broad live-proof tracker.

options.title: Keep broad tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical broad tracker and require native Windows proof that the narrower fixes resolve the end-to-end restart and post-ready health symptoms.

options.title: Route to narrow issues
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90158 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91144 as the remaining canonical work and close this only after their fixes land or the post-ready symptom is separately disproven.

options.title: Request fresh logs
options.body: Ask the reporter or a maintainer to rerun current main on Windows and attach restart, status, and health evidence before deciding the remaining scope.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical broad tracker and require native Windows proof that the narrower fixes resolve the end-to-end restart and post-ready health symptoms.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and already owns the recent policy-close restart-health repair connected to this issue.
